title: Matching demonstratives with plural nouns
focus: Match a plural demonstrative with a visibly supplied nominative plural noun.

exercises.prompt: Choose the sentence that means “These books are at home.” During a memory exercise. Use the supplied plural kirjat (“books”) and kotona (“at home”).
exercises.explanation: Nämä and kirjat are both plural, so the demonstrative and noun agree in number.

sentenceExplanation.translation: These books are at home.
sentenceExplanation.pattern: plural demonstrative agreeing with the noun + plural noun + linking verb + location

parts.role: plural demonstrative agreeing with the noun

parts.formation: the complete T-plural form is supplied

Correct. Nämä and kirjat are both plural, so the demonstrative and noun agree in number.
“Tämä” is a singular nominative form for a referent near the speaker; use “Nämä”, a plural nominative form for referents near the speaker.
“Nämä kirja ovat kotona.” changes the supplied form or word order. The required sentence is “Nämä kirjat ovat kotona.”: Nämä and kirjat are both plural, so the demonstrative and noun agree in number.
